summary: A board considering rival names for the same stream can close the case without choosing either.
realLife: Members discussed local recommendations for Chitch Creek and Newcosta Creek. A motion favoring Newcosta was withdrawn before a vote, and the committee then rejected both names.
inGame: needs: the alternatives for one stream, the local recommendations and the final disposition of each.

turns.what: The board votes on rejecting both.
turns.writesBack: The decision approves no name for the stream.

turns.pulledBy: One municipality clarifies its preference before the vote.
turns.writesBack: The clarification joins the record before action.
